questions.question: In Morning Glory, what job does Mike Pomeroy reluctantly return to?
questions.note: Ford’s veteran newsman is pulled onto a struggling morning program.

questions.question: Cowboys & Aliens combines a Western setting with an invasion by what?
questions.note: Ford’s Colonel Dolarhyde joins Daniel Craig’s outlaw against extraterrestrial attackers.

questions.question: In 42, which baseball pioneer does Branch Rickey sign to the Brooklyn Dodgers?
questions.note: Ford plays the Dodgers executive who helps break Major League Baseball’s color barrier.

questions.question: In Paranoia, what is Harrison Ford’s ruthless technology mogul named?
questions.note: Ford plays Goddard opposite Gary Oldman in the corporate-thriller.

questions.question: In Anchorman 2, which veteran television-news figure does Harrison Ford play?
questions.note: Ford has a comic cameo as legendary anchorman Mack Harken.

questions.question: In The Expendables 3, what is Ford’s CIA character named?
questions.note: Ford joins the action franchise as the CIA operative Max Drummer.

questions.question: In The Age of Adaline, what unusual condition affects the title character?
questions.note: Ford’s William Jones knew Adaline decades before his son does.

questions.question: In The Secret Life of Pets 2, whose voice does Harrison Ford provide?
questions.note: Rooster is the farm dog who teaches Duke some confidence.

questions.question: What kind of story is Ender’s Game, in which Ford plays Colonel Graff?
questions.note: The film follows young recruits being trained to defend Earth from an alien threat.

questions.question: Which actor plays the young protagonist opposite Ford in Ender’s Game?
questions.note: Butterfield plays Ender Wiggin, whom Graff recruits for Battle School.
